parameters.content:
## YouTube Video Comment & Reply Thread Scraper

**Actor:** [YouTube Video Comment & Reply Thread Scraper](https://apify.com/nimbryxo-studio/youtube-video-comment-and-reply-thread-scraper)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/youtube-video-comment-and-reply-thread-scraper.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `videoUrls` (array)
- `channelUrls` (array)
- `playlistUrls` (array)
- `searchQueries` (array)
- `maxVideosPerSource` (integer)
- `maxComments` (integer)
- `includeReplies` (boolean)
- `maxRepliesPerComment` (integer)
- `maxReplyDepth` (integer)
- `maxTotalRows` (integer)
- `sortBy` (string)
- `commentsSince` (string)

### Output fields
- `commentId` (Comment ID)
- `authorName` (Author)
- `text` (Text)
- `likeCount` (Likes)
- `replyCount` (Replies)
- `isHearted` (Hearted)
- `videoTitle` (Video)

description: YouTube video comment scraper: runs the YouTube Video Comment & Reply Thread Scraper Apify Actor, returns authorName, text, likeCount, replyCount, isHearted and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
